At Magnolia State Construction, we believe the smallest details make the biggest impact—and nothing highlights that more than professional trim work. From elegant crown molding and baseboards to window and door casings, our skilled team sources quality materials to create a cohesive look that complements everything from flooring to ceilings.

For commercial properties, we provide clean, durable trim work that complements your business environment and reflects your brand. Whether it’s a retail storefront, office suite, or hospitality space, we work with contractors, designers, and business owners to deliver efficient, professional trim installation tailored to the building’s purpose and aesthetic.

In residential settings, trim work brings charm and structure to every room. Whether you’re upgrading a single room or completing a full home renovation, our local team delivers trim work with careful attention to fit, finish, and long-term durability. At Magnolia State Construction, we treat every home like it’s our own.

Granite brings a timeless beauty and unmatched durability to any space—and at Magnolia State Construction, we make sure it’s done with expert precision and creative vision. Whether it’s a kitchen countertop, bathroom vanity, or custom feature, granite offers a natural elegance that transforms everyday surfaces into standout features. 

In residential settings, granite is a favorite for its strength, low maintenance, and ability to elevate the heart of the home. We work closely with homeowners to design and install granite surfaces that are both beautiful and built to last—from polished countertops that make kitchens shine to custom bathroom vanities that turn morning routines into something special. 

For commercial projects, granite sends a message of professionalism, quality, and attention to detail. Whether you’re upgrading a front desk, installing countertops in a shared kitchen space, or designing restrooms with a high-end feel, we deliver granite solutions that are functional, durable, and visually impressive. Backed by over 15 years of experience, Magnolia State Construction provides commercial granite installations that withstand daily use while enhancing the look and feel of your space.
